decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently combo off by milling your entire deck into the graveyard and then using cards like Thassa's Oracle, Bridge from Below, and Dread Return to win the game on the spot. The deck includes various tools like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize to disrupt your opponent's game plan and protect your combo. The deck is designed to win as fast as possible without needing to rely on traditional methods of combat or board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards such as Golgari Grave-Troll and Golgari Thug, which will trigger abilities like Narcomoeba and Bridge from Below. By utilizing powerful reanimation spells like Dread Return, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent with a large board presence. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Otherworldly Gaze and Cabal Therapy help to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect the combo pieces. Overall, this deck aims to efficiently assemble the necessary pieces to win the game as quickly as possible.

The deck focuses on using a combination of cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to quickly bring powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield, bypassing their mana costs. It also includes cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will for disruption and protection, as well as card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to help find combo pieces. The deck seeks to quickly reanimate threats to overwhelm the opponent and win the game before they can respond effectively.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bringing them back to the battlefield with Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The deck utilizes a variety of creatures with strong abilities like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and has some utility creatures like Brazen Borrower and Orcish Bowmasters. The mana base includes a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combination of artifacts to generate mana and card advantage, allowing you to quickly advance your board state and overwhelm your opponent with powerful threats. Mystic Forge is a key card in the deck, allowing you to play cards off the top of your library and dig deeper into your deck for combo pieces. By utilizing a mix of mana acceleration and card selection, you can establish a dominant presence on the battlefield and outpace your opponent in the Legacy format.

The main concept of this deck is to rapidly generate mana through artifacts like Ancient Tomb and Lotus Petal, then use the combo of Mystic Forge and Manifold Key to continuously manipulate the top of the library and cast artifacts for free. Karn, the Great Creator and Tezzeret, Cruel Captain provide additional value and utility, with cards like The One Ring and Planar Nexus serving as win conditions. The deck aims to create a powerful engine that can quickly overwhelm opponents with a combination of card advantage, mana acceleration, and powerful artifacts.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. The deck uses mana acceleration like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb to ramp into larger threats like Reality Smasher and Sire of Seven Deaths. By using Eldrazi Temple and Eye of Ugin, the deck can cast its creatures ahead of schedule and overwhelm the opponent with a fast, aggressive strategy. Wastes and Wasteland provide additional utility and disruption to control the pace of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing lands and various control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck focuses on building up powerful lands such as Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a powerful threat, while using cards like Wasteland and Life from the Loam to disrupt the opponent's mana base. These lands can also be utilized to generate card advantage and provide protection through cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and win through strategic land manipulation.

The main focus of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi creatures like Reality Smasher and Thought-Knot Seer. By utilizing mana acceleration cards like Lotus Petal and Grim Monolith, the deck aims to get these massive creatures onto the battlefield as quickly as possible. Additionally, cards like Chalice of the Void help disrupt the opponent's strategy while cards like Kozilek's Command provide additional versatility in controlling the board. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to establish a fast and aggressive board presence with Eldrazi creatures in order to win the game efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Ancient Tomb and Simian Spirit Guide to cast powerful threats like Magus of the Moon and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck aims to disrupt opponents' game plans with cards like Chalice of the Void and Blood Moon, while also controlling the board with cards like Sundering Eruption and Fury. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive, disruptive plays and close out the game quickly with powerful creatures like The One Ring and Pyrogoyf.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage and control of the board. The deck uses a combination of counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, and card draw/filtering with Brainstorm and Preordain. The deck also includes threats like Murktide Regent and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to close out the game. The mana base is built to support a variety of spells with access to multiple colors.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying a large number of nonland cards onto the battlefield to combo off and win the game in one explosive turn. By using powerful mana acceleration, disruptive spells, and graveyard recursion, the deck aims to mill itself quickly to put Thassa's Oracle or Memory's Journey on top of the library and win the game. It utilizes cards like Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, and Pact of Negation to provide the resources needed for the combo, while also running protection in the form of Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize to disrupt opponents' plans.

The core concept of this Legacy Patriot Aggro deck is to quickly establish board presence and pressure the opponent with aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor, Mockingbird, and Ocelot Pride, supported by disruption spells like Force of Will, Daze, and Swords to Plowshares. The deck aims to maintain card advantage and tempo through cards like Brainstorm and Ponder while also utilizing Goblin Bombardment as a versatile finisher. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's aggressive strategy while also providing access to all necessary colors of mana.
